scope_note: Broad title-level corpus of Einstein works explicitly concerning light, radiation, electrodynamics, propagation, emission/absorption or closely coupled quantum-light questions, derived from the official publication list. This is intentionally broader than the small primary-text core but does not claim that every Einstein text containing an incidental mention of light has been enumerated.
